definition: Amjad Masad (Arabic: أمجد مسعد; born 1987 or 1988) is a Jordanian-American billionaire entrepreneur.
details: Built browser-based collaborative coding environment Replit and Replit Agent, enabling natural-language full-stack software creation. He is the founder and CEO of Replit. Before Replit, Masad worked at Facebook, overseeing the JavaScript infrastructure team and also as a founding engineer at Codecademy.

explainer.lead: Amjad Masad is a Jordanian-American businessman.

timeline.what: Before Facebook, Masad was a founding engineer at Codecademy from November 2011 to October 2013.
